The clock ran from `first` at 08:22:37Z to the `stop:` line at 08:32:57Z. **Milestones (minutes from t0)** | step | min | 360 / 1440 / 2560 % | |---|---|---| | `first` done | 1.4 | 28.31 / 38.25 / 29.06 | | r1 (document re-authored, all CSS written) | 6.9 | 14.17 / 4.06 / 2.39 | | r2 | 8.6 | 10.97 / 4.04 / 2.38 | | r3 = `stop:` | 10.3 | **6.74 / 4.04 / 2.38** | | served gate (after the clock) | 12.7 | **9.53 / 4.05 / 2.39** | - **Setup:** about 1 min of wall clock (repo created 08:21:37Z, t0 08:22:37Z). The GitHub repo didn't exist before the run. The DA folder existed but was empty. - **Tool time, t0 → stop (TIMING.log):** 197 s (first 84, harness 11, r1 36, r2 33, r3 33). The other ~7 min was me reading and writing. - **Deploy:** code pushed to `blocks-first`. The page, nav and footer are uploaded to DA and previewed only, never published. I also skipped the publish step in the site-setup skill. Served page: https://blocks-first--sdt-rbc-b10--aemcoder-adobe.aem.page/drafts/rbc-home - **Leak:** prototype and served page match at 1440. At 360 the callout cards are 24 px taller on the served page. DA wraps each news link in its own `

` inside the list item. I logged it in REGISTER.md and didn't fix it, since there are no polish rounds. **Five largest non-tool chunks** 1. Writing all the CSS in one pass: ~2 min 2. Reading `first`'s output and side-by-sides, deciding to re-author the document: ~1.5 min 3. Rewriting the page document and adding missing rows to the nav document: ~1 min 4. Reading the section cards, the 360 tiles and the header/footer code: ~1 min 5. Each of the r1→r2 and r2→r3 fix passes: ~1.2 min **Three tool defects that cost the most** 1. **Wrong blocks, dropped content (~3 min).** Triage called About RBC (accordion + teasers) and Our Operations (tabs + icon grid) `carousel`. `author` then dropped the accordion items, the tabs and the icons, and flattened the three callout cards. I re-authored the document by hand. 2. **Incomplete nav (~1 min).** The nav document was missing the tools row (Contact Us, EN, Sign In) and the white sub-nav. 3. **Broken social icons (~0.5 min).** The footer's social icons point to `/icons/`, but the media went to `drafts/media/`, so 5 images were broken in every capture. A smaller one: the draft's 1128 px content width is wrong for the card rows, which span 1170. The prompt's round command uses port 8990, but `first` served the harness on 8991; I used 8991. Files are in `sdt-rbc-b10/migration/cases/home/`: - NOTES.md - TIMELINE.md - REPORT.md - REGISTER.md - TIMING.log
